counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: British Cameroons (Southern and Northern Cameroons, UN trust territory)

problems: Cliopatria's British East Africa row (1961-1972) is not the East Africa Protectorate: shape 1 is Britain's remaining colonies in Africa (Uganda, Kenya, Malawi, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Botswana, Lesotho, Eswatini, the Gambia), shape 2 is the Seychelles. The dossier is written as 'British Africa (remaining colonies)' (type colony) and ends at the Seychelles' independence on 29 June 1976; the rows for Uganda, Kenya (from 1963) and Malawi, Zambia, the Gambia, Botswana, Lesotho, Rhodesia (from 1967) start after the independence dates, so those dossiers need keyframes back to 1962-1966 or the land is blank; Swaziland is drawn twice (this shape to 1968 and the swaziland dossier 1908-1968).

Burkina Faso and the Central African Republic became independent in August 1960 but Cliopatria's rows start in 1961 and its French Fifth Republic 1960 shape still holds them (and Niger, Chad, Gabon): both dossiers found in 1960 with a new 1960 keyframe; the French dossier (eu-22) must lose them in 1960 or both are drawn.

Start convention: sovereign independence for all six states; the 1958-1959 self-rule within the French Community is left to the French dossier as a client relation. Mali Federation and Republic of Mali are one dossier (slug mali-federation, name Mali) with a split (Senegal, 20 August 1960) and a rename (22 September 1960); Senegal's row starts in 1961 so its dossier should found in August 1960.

Cameroon's 1961 gain of Southern Cameroons uses counterpart british-gold-coast (the Cliopatria holder, as the Nigeria dossier does for Northern Cameroons); the real owner, British Cameroons, has no row. Cliopatria's 1961-2023 Cameroon shape includes Bakassi, which Nigeria held to 2006-2008; the dossier adjusts it and adds a 2008 keyframe.

Rebel dossiers azawad and seleka were added as direct counterparts (type rebel); azawad lasted under a year and seleka is a coalition, so the colour agent may treat them as short-lived or merge them into a generic rebel hatch.
